Setorwu Data-Adzah

  • Senior Finance Officer

Setorwu Data-Adzah is a highly accomplished individual with a diverse skill set and a passion for financial management. He graduated from the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, where he specialized in Accounting and Finance at the School of Business. Additionally, he holds a certification as a Financial Modelling and Valuation Analyst (FMVA) from the Corporate Finance Institute, demonstrating his expertise in the field. Setorwu’s proficiency in technology is evident, as he is known for being tech-savvy. He possesses advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and enjoys sharing his expertise with others. As a natural educator, he provides basic Excel training to his colleagues both within and outside his work environment, fostering their professional growth.

Before joining AIMS Ghana, Setorwu gained valuable experience as a Finance Analyst at Nestle Central and West Africa. This role allowed him to enhance his financial acumen and further develop his analytical skills.

At AIMS Ghana, Setorwu is committed to ensuring the organization’s financial management success. With his expertise and dedication, he contributes to the efficient handling of financial matters, supporting the growth and sustainability of the organization.
